UI_AA_ModName: Auto All - Cook, Read, Tailoring and Reload
UI_AA_cook_option_tt: Fills the dish on its own with the best ingredients within reach, spreading the food types so the meal does not make you unhappy. Recipe limit: %1 ingredients. Reachable now: %2.
UI_AA_cook_return_failed: Could not put %1 ingredient(s) back - they are still in your inventory.
UI_AA_cook_interrupted: Auto cooking stopped: the ingredient could not be added.
UI_AA_cook_noingredients: Nothing within reach can go into this recipe.
UI_AA_tailor_button_tt: Patches every body part of this garment, unpicks the patches and starts over. Needs a needle, thread and rags. The garment does not have to be worn. Stops when you move or press ESC.
UI_AA_tailor_interrupted: Tailoring training stopped: the stitch did not go through.
UI_AA_tailor_nofabric: Tailoring training needs rags, denim strips or leather strips.
UI_AA_tailor_lost: Tailoring training stopped: the garment is gone.
UI_AA_read_option_tt: Reads every skill book and skill magazine within reach, one after the other, and puts each one back. Found now: %1 books and %2 magazines. Books above or below your level are skipped.
UI_AA_read_nothing: Nothing within reach still teaches you anything.
UI_AA_reload_option_tt: Loads and unloads this over and over to train Reloading. Currently %1/%2 rounds, %3 spare in the inventory. Stops when you move or press ESC.
UI_AA_reload_option_mag_tt: Trains on %1, the magazine this gun feeds from. Currently %2/%3 rounds, %4 spare in the inventory. Stops when you move or press ESC.
UI_AA_reload_nomagazine: This gun feeds from a magazine - carry one to train on it.
UI_AA_reload_interrupted: Reload training stopped: the reload did not go through.
UI_AA_reload_lost: Reload training stopped: the magazine is gone.
UI_AA_opt_cookMaxIngredients_tt: Stop before the recipe is full. 0 uses whatever the recipe allows.
UI_AA_opt_cookSameTypeMax: Max copies of the same ingredient
UI_AA_opt_cookSameTypeMax_tt: Piling the same food in a dish is what makes it depressing to eat. 2 is a safe value.
UI_AA_opt_cookSpices_tt: Adds the spices you have once the ingredients are in.
UI_AA_opt_cookSpiceMax_tt: How many spices at most may go into one dish.
UI_AA_opt_cookPriority_tt: What the picker maximises when it chooses the next ingredient.
UI_AA_opt_cookSkipUnhappy_tt: Skips ingredients that add unhappiness while a better one is still available.
UI_AA_opt_cookSkipRotten_tt: Never puts rotten, burnt or tainted food in the pot.
UI_AA_opt_cookSkipPoison_tt: Never puts poisonous items in the pot.
UI_AA_opt_cookSkipFavorite_tt: Items flagged as favourite are left alone.
UI_AA_opt_cookReturnItems_tt: Returns ingredients borrowed from a cupboard or fridge once the meal is done. The finished dish always stays in your inventory.
UI_AA_opt_tailorFabric_tt: Which material the training sews on. Any picks the cheapest one you carry.
UI_AA_opt_tailorMaxCycles_tt: One cycle is patching every body part and unpicking them all again.
UI_AA_opt_tailorHolesFirst_tt: Sews the actual holes before padding intact parts.
UI_AA_opt_readSkillBooks_tt: Books that raise an XP multiplier, as long as the level band fits your character.
UI_AA_opt_readMagazines_tt: Magazines that still hold at least one recipe you do not know.
UI_AA_opt_readNearby_tt: Off means only the books already in your inventory and bags are read.
UI_AA_opt_readReturnItems_tt: Returns each book to the container it was taken from.
UI_AA_opt_readMaxBooks_tt: Stops once this many books and magazines have been read.
UI_AA_opt_reloadMaxCycles_tt: One cycle is filling the magazine and emptying it again.
UI_AA_opt_stopOnMove_tt: Pressing a movement key always stops the automation.
UI_AA_opt_stopOnAim_tt: Stops as soon as you raise the weapon.
UI_AA_opt_stopZombie_tt: Stops as soon as a zombie is seen or chasing.
UI_AA_opt_stopDamage_tt: Stops when overall body health drops.
UI_AA_opt_fastForward_tt: Single player only - the server owns game speed in multiplayer. It is only taken from normal speed, and if you change the speed yourself the mod stops touching it for the rest of that job.
UI_AA_opt_notify_tt: How the mod tells you what it is doing.
UI_AA_opt_notifyEvery_tt: Seconds before the same progress message shows up again.
UI_AA_clean_with_soap_tt: Washes you, your clothes, your gear and your dirty bandages - %1 things in all. Soap, bleach or cleaning liquid in reach is used automatically, which is about five times faster.
UI_AA_clean_without_soap_tt: Washes you, your clothes, your gear and your dirty bandages - %1 things in all. Water only, so it takes considerably longer.
UI_AA_clean_no_soap: No soap, bleach or cleaning liquid within reach.
UI_AA_clean_natural_note: This water is tainted. It washes exactly the same, and it does not affect infection - sterilising is what does.
UI_AA_clean_no_water: There is no water here. Sinks run dry once the water supply is shut off.
UI_AA_clean_dry: Cleaning stopped: the water ran out after %1 things.
UI_AA_steril_option_tt: Sterilizes them one after the other with the alcohol or boiled water in reach. Ready to do: %1 of %2.
UI_AA_steril_nosupplies: Not enough rubbing alcohol, spirits or hot water within reach.
UI_AA_cook_skilled: Your cooking is good enough to use the sad end of the pantry.
UI_AA_opt_cleanSelf_tt: Off means only clothes, gear and bandages are washed.
UI_AA_opt_cleanWring: Wring the clothes out and put them back on
UI_AA_opt_cleanWring_tt: After the washing, wrings out every wet garment and dresses the character again in whatever it was wearing. The base game takes the clothes off to wring them and leaves them in your inventory.
UI_AA_opt_sterilReturnItems: Put the alcohol back when finished
UI_AA_opt_sterilReturnItems_tt: Returns the leftover alcohol or water to the container it was taken from, once, after the whole batch. Turn this off to simply keep it.
UI_AA_opt_dismantleReturnItems: Put the screwdriver back when finished
UI_AA_opt_dismantleReturnItems_tt: Returns the screwdriver to the container it was taken from, once, after the whole batch. Turn this off to simply keep it.
UI_AA_opt_dismantleResultsToSource: Send the scrap back where it came from
UI_AA_opt_dismantleResultsToSource_tt: When the electronics were taken from a crate, a cupboard or the floor, the parts go back there at the end instead of weighing the character down. Used on something already carried, the parts stay in the inventory.
UI_AA_opt_dismantleMax_tt: Caps how many are taken apart in one go. 0 means as many as there are.
UI_AA_dismantle_option_tt: Takes apart %1 of the %2 within reach, one after another, for Electrical XP. Any that are in a container are fetched, and the screwdriver is only picked up once.
UI_AA_dismantle_inuse: Those are being worn or carried. Take one off first, or use a spare.
UI_AA_dismantle_keeping: Leaving %1 alone: worn or in hand.
UI_AA_opt_cookBadFromLevel: Use bad ingredients from Cooking level
UI_AA_opt_cookBadFromLevel_tt: From this Cooking level the picker stops avoiding rotten and depressing ingredients. 0 never allows them. Poison is always refused.
UI_AA_rip_option_tt: Will rip %1 of the %2 within reach.
UI_AA_rip_keeping: Leaving %1 alone: worn, held or favourite.
UI_AA_rip_notool: No scissors or sharp knife within reach.
UI_AA_rip_protected: Only worn, held or favourite items here.
UI_AA_opt_ripSkipFavorite_tt: Items flagged as favourite are left alone, wherever they are.
UI_AA_opt_ripReturnItems_tt: The cutting tool goes back to the container it came from, once, at the end.
UI_AA_opt_ripResultsToSource: Send the strips to the source
UI_AA_opt_ripResultsToSource_tt: Ripped sheets and strips go back to the container the clothing came from.
UI_AA_opt_ripMax_tt: 0 means as many as the batch allows.
UI_AA_repair_option_all: Auto Repair: every hole within reach
UI_AA_repair_option_all_tt: %1 holes across everything within reach, worn clothes included.
UI_AA_repair_noholes: Nothing here has a hole in it.
UI_AA_repair_nomaterials: Not enough thread or fabric to sew with.
UI_AA_mech_nothing: Nothing on this car can be worked on right now.
UI_AA_mech_inside: Get out of the vehicle first.
UI_AA_opt_mechMax_tt: 0 means every part it can do.
UI_AA_cook_setup_tt: Opens a window to choose the dish, what it is for, and how much of each ingredient goes in.
UI_AA_cook_size_auto: As many as the recipe allows
UI_AA_cook_ui_hint: Left click a row to raise it, right click to lower it.
UI_AA_mech_minchance: Only parts the game rates %1 or better
UI_AA_mech_will_break: Parts will break at this level!
UI_AA_mech_disposable: Use a car you can afford to lose
UI_AA_mech_parts_safe: Parts are safe at this setting
UI_AA_mech_skipping: %1 parts skipped: the odds are too low
UI_AA_mech_nokey: Without the key, some parts stay locked.
UI_AA_mech_seats: To work on seats, make sure they are empty.
UI_AA_opt_mechMinSuccess_tt: Parts the game gives a lower chance than this are skipped instead of risked. 0 works on everything, 30 will not wreck the car, 100 never risks a part. The chances themselves are the game's and are never changed.
UI_AA_mech_stuck: Stuck on this car - %1 parts done.
UI_AA_mech_left_off: %1 parts done, but %2 could not be refitted - see console.txt.
UI_AA_stop_stuck: Stopped: an action would not finish.
UI_AA_opt_mechFailSound_tt: Single player only. The base game plays this sound on a failed part through the server, so it is silent when there is no server. This plays it for you. It is heard, not carried: it does not draw zombies the way the multiplayer one does.
UI_AA_stop_hurt: Stopped: too hurt to keep carrying this.
UI_AA_opt_modules_desc: Turn off anything you do not use. Its menu entries disappear completely, so the right click menu only shows what you actually want.
UI_AA_opt_modules_tt: On by default. A server can also switch this off for everyone in its sandbox options.
UI_AA_opt_discord_desc: Our Discord is where bugs get reported, ideas get discussed, people find others to play with, and new mods are announced. Come and say hello.
UI_AA_opt_discord_tt: Opens the invite in the Steam overlay, or in your browser when the overlay is off.
UI_AA_cook_option_hidden: Auto Cook: recipes hidden for this item
UI_AA_cook_norecipes: This item is set to hide its recipes, which is a base game setting, not a mod one - the game's own cooking options are hidden too. Right click the item and choose Show Recipes to bring them all back.
UI_AA_dismantle_option_all: Auto Dismantle: every electronic within reach
UI_AA_wring_option_tt: Wrings out %1 wet garments, one after another, putting each one back on afterwards.
UI_AA_wring_nothing: Nothing you are carrying is wet enough to wring.
UI_AA_rip_from_body: %1 more will be taken off the bodies first.
UI_AA_reload_ejecting: The magazine will be taken out of the gun first.
UI_AA_reload_stuck: The rounds are not moving. Stopped - check console.txt.
UI_AA_opt_showTab: Auto All tab in the character window
UI_AA_opt_showTab_tt: Turn this off to take the tab out of the character window. Nothing is lost: every setting it holds is also here in Mod Options. Useful on a controller, where one fewer tab is one fewer to cycle past.
UI_AA_opt_vhsNearby: Also take tapes from nearby containers
UI_AA_opt_vhsNearby_tt: With this on, the shelves and boxes open in the loot window count as well, not just what the character is carrying.
UI_AA_opt_vhsReturnItems: Put each tape back where it came from
UI_AA_opt_vhsReturnItems_tt: Turn this off to keep the watched tapes in the inventory instead.
UI_AA_opt_vhsMaxTapes: Stop after this many tapes (0 = no limit)
UI_AA_opt_vhsMaxTapes_tt: At zero it keeps going until nothing within reach still teaches anything.
UI_AA_vhs_option_tt: Plays %1 tapes through the video player one after another, taking each one out when its programme ends. Tapes that only pass the time are left alone.
UI_AA_vhs_nothing: No tape within reach still teaches anything.
UI_AA_vhs_nodevice: There is no video player nearby.
UI_AA_vhs_nopower: The video player has no power.
UI_AA_vhs_toofar: Too far from the video player to follow the programme.
UI_AA_vhs_stuck: The video player stopped responding. Stopped - check console.txt.
UI_AA_opt_medDisinfect_tt: Uses alcohol or an alcoholic drink on each open wound before dressing it, exactly as the Health window would. Turn it off to save your alcohol - the bandaging still happens.
UI_AA_med_option_tt: Treats %1 injured body part(s): bullets and glass out, burns washed, wounds disinfected and bandaged. A sterilised bandage is used first when you have one.
UI_AA_med_nosupplies: No bandages or tools within reach.
UI_MM_auto_tt: Trains, rests and starts again on its own until you stop it or something interrupts.
UI_MM_running_tt: Auto training is already running. Use Cancel to stop it.
UI_MM_wait_pain: In too much pain to train...
UI_MM_takingBooze: Having a sip for the pain...
UI_MM_noFood: Hungry, but no safe food in the bag...
UI_MM_stop_vehicle: Auto training stopped: inside a vehicle.
UI_MM_stop_damage: Auto training stopped: you are taking damage.
UI_MM_stop_health: Auto training stopped: health too low.
UI_MM_stop_load: Auto training stopped: carrying too much.
UI_MM_stop_cantstart: Auto training stopped: the exercise could not start.
UI_MM_opt_restOnFurniture_tt: Prefers a bed, couch or mat within reach over the ground; walks back to the training spot afterwards.
UI_MM_opt_travelRange_tt: How far the character will walk to a rest spot or, with FWO installed, to the treadmill/bench.
UI_MM_opt_restAt_tt: The character ends the set and rests when endurance drops to this value.
UI_MM_opt_resumeAt_tt: The character stands up and starts the next set at this endurance.
UI_MM_opt_setMinutes_tt: In-game minutes per set. The value on the fitness panel wins when you press OK.
UI_MM_opt_maxSets_tt: How many sets it does per run before stopping on its own. 0 trains until you stop it.
UI_MM_opt_sitToRest: Sit on the ground to rest
UI_MM_opt_rotate_tt: One exercise per set, cycling through every exercise you have the equipment for.
UI_MM_opt_treatPain_tt: Take something for the pain while resting instead of just waiting.
UI_MM_opt_painLevel: Pain moodle level that triggers it
UI_MM_opt_usePills_tt: Swallows a painkiller from the inventory.
UI_MM_opt_useBooze_tt: Falls back to an alcoholic drink when there are no painkillers.
UI_MM_opt_boozeSip_tt: How much of the container is drunk per sip.
UI_MM_opt_maxDrunk_tt: Never drink above this intoxication level.
UI_MM_opt_autoEat_tt: Eats from the inventory when hunger kicks in. Skips rotten, dangerous raw, poisonous food and spices.
UI_MM_opt_eatAt_tt: 1 = peckish, 4 = starving. Only the needed fraction of the item is eaten, so nothing is wasted.
UI_MM_opt_useNearby_tt: Also takes food, painkillers and drinks from bags, containers and the floor around, walking there if needed.
UI_MM_opt_nearbyRange_tt: How far around the character to look for items.
UI_MM_opt_putItemBack_tt: Returns what was not fully consumed to the container or the floor it came from.
UI_MM_opt_stopZombie_tt: Stops as soon as a zombie is seen or chasing.
UI_MM_opt_stopDamage_tt: Stops when overall body health drops.
UI_MM_opt_stopLowHealth_tt: Stops when overall body health is below the limit below.
UI_MM_opt_stopManual_tt: Stops when you move or aim.
UI_MM_opt_stopHeavyLoad_tt: Stops when the heavy load moodle gets too high.
UI_MM_opt_stopOnClose: Stop when the panel is closed
UI_MM_opt_stopOnClose_tt: Off means training keeps going with the window closed.
UI_MM_opt_autoDefault_tt: The AUTO box starts ticked when the fitness panel opens.
UI_MM_opt_fastForward_tt: Single player only. The server owns game speed in multiplayer.
UI_MM_opt_holdSpeed_tt: Without this the game drops back to normal speed between sets.
UI_MM_opt_notify_tt: How the mod tells you what it is doing.
UI_MM_opt_notifyEvery_tt: Seconds before the same waiting message shows up again.
UI_MM_win_button_tt: Opens the mod's own options window.
UI_MM_discord_button_tt: Opens a small window with our Discord invite link.
UI_MM_opt_showSummary_tt: A small card with sets, time and XP gained appears for a few seconds when auto training stops.
UI_AA_dismantle_blocked: Nothing here can be taken apart right now. Worn, broken or already-used items do not count.
UI_AA_opt_openReturnItems: Put the can opener back when finished
UI_AA_opt_openReturnItems_tt: Returns the can opener or knife to the container it was taken from, once, after the whole batch. Turn this off to simply keep it.
UI_AA_opt_openResultsToSource: Send the opened food back where it came from
UI_AA_opt_openResultsToSource_tt: When the tins were taken from a fridge, a crate or the floor, the opened food goes back there at the end instead of weighing the character down. Used on something already carried, it stays in the inventory.
UI_AA_opt_openMax_tt: Caps how many are opened in one go. 0 means as many as there are.
UI_AA_open_option_all: Open Every Can and Jar Within Reach
UI_AA_open_option_tt: Opens %1 of the %2 within reach, one after another. Any that are in a container are fetched, and the can opener is only picked up once.
UI_AA_open_notool: No can opener or sharp knife within reach.
UI_AA_opt_cookSpoilFirst: Use up the food closest to spoiling
UI_AA_opt_cookSpoilFirst_tt: Among the ingredients on offer, prefers the ones with the least time left before they go stale. Nothing rotten is ever used - that is a separate setting.
UI_AA_rip_blocked: Found things to rip, but none of them can be right now. Try again in a moment.
